data.comparison_scope: This is a deliberately scoped10-record historical rRNA/ITS marker panel:all7upstream records containingN plus the first3upstream entries as fixed comparison records. Every selected source sequence is retained completely. The selection is a declared data-quality exercise,not a representative sample of orchid species or all94upstream records. Do not trim,align away unresolved regions,drop uncertain records or infer whole-genome composition or adaptation.
data.composition_policy: Compute a point GC percentage among resolved A/C/G/T characters separately from the attainable GC percentage over the entire supplied marker string. Each N independently denotes any one ofA/C/G/T;no missing-at-random,50%GC or statistical imputation model is assumed. There are no gaps or other ambiguity codes in this panel. A record is a possible top-rank if some allowed completion makes it at least tied for the greatest full-marker GC percentage. A unique all-completion maximizer requires strict superiority under every allowed completion;ties defeat uniqueness.
data.margin_policy: Report the lower full-marker GC percentage of the known-bases point winner minus the greatest upper full-marker GC percentage among the other panel records,using percentage points. This is an attainable worst-case rank margin,not a confidence interval or probability.

source_provenance.data_status: Authentic public GenBank/EMBL marker strings in the Biopython example snapshot. No experimental sequence or ambiguity was fabricated.
source_provenance.export: Exact original identifiers,descriptions and complete nucleotide strings retained for the explicitly scoped panel. Only FASTA wrapping is changed to one complete sequence line per record;no GC value,bound or ranking is exported.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
